title: finding(tooling): BASELINE.gzipBytes was measured 22 commits before the tree that merged — three framework source files changed in between and nobody has weighed them
body:
Found while recording ruling item (2) of objectui#7848 (docs-only PR objectui#9208). ⛔ Not folded in there: that PR is prose about the mechanism, and this is a measurement nobody has taken.

## The defect

`BASELINE.gzipBytes = 3_164_817` in `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` is a reading of `755d34a5f`. That commit is **the first commit of objectui#7479's branch**, not the pull request that carried it.

- `d8b4739d4` (the control build) to `755d34a5f` is `ahead_by=1` — the A/B in the docblock is clean, and that half is confirmed.
- `755d34a5f` to the branch head `d7d6c6a688` is `ahead_by=22`. One of those commits, `bf268c3723`, merges 15 further commits of `main` in.
- The branch squash-merged onto `main` as `77b2a18a16`.

Three of the 22 edit **non-test source inside `framework`'s own `advancedChunks` group**, `packages/(core|react|types)` — 175 added lines against 47 removed:

```
modified  +35   -32   packages/core/src/utils/filter-tokens.ts
modified  +118  -8    packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx
modified  +22   -7    packages/react/src/hooks/usePageAssignment.ts
```

Control with a known direction, same filter over the same 79-file compare, test files instead of source — non-empty, so the filter is discriminating rather than matching nothing:

```
added     +157  -0    packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/filter-tokens.spec-derived-7265.test.ts
added     +322  -0    packages/react/src/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.enablementEnvelopeConfigBag.test.tsx
added     +192  -0    packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/usePageAssignment.declarationOrder-7298.test.tsx
```

## Why it matters, and why it is not already covered

The `BASELINE` docblock warns about the other direction only: "CI weighs the pull-request MERGE ref and this is the branch tree, so the two differ by whatever has landed on `main` since". It does not cover the branch's own commits landing **after** the reading was taken.

⇒ the constant under-reports the tree that actually merged, by an amount **nobody has measured**. That matters beyond bookkeeping: objectui#7848's round measured the live aggregate at 3,186,729 on `1f4e02995a` and read the 21,912-byte excess over `BASELINE.gzipBytes` as post-merge drift. An unknown part of it was already on the branch at merge time and is not drift at all. The board is currently attributing bytes to a window they did not arrive in.

## What would settle it

One console build of `77b2a18a16` (reachable from `main`, unlike `755d34a5f`), read out of `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json` and compared against 3,164,817. That splits the 21,912 into "present at merge" and "arrived since", which is the number the re-baseline discipline actually needs.

⛔ Deliberately **not** a request to move any constant. If the split turns out to be material, what it asks for is a rule — take the reading on the tree you are about to merge — and objectui#9208 already writes that rule into the file as prose. This card is the measurement.

## Not covered elsewhere

Checked against 444 open issues by repository-scoped listing plus local grep (the `/search` endpoint is 403 for this session by design). `BASELINE.commit` 0 hits, "merge ref" 0, "squash-merge" 0; control term "eager closure" hits 3, so the scan was not blind. objectui#6319 is the adjacent card and is a different mechanism — a CI verdict that finishes before a ceiling changes under it, not a baseline measured mid-branch. objectui#9205 is the `framework` ceiling drifting the opposite way. objectui#9204 is the `ui-components` slimming route.
